def run(name,fn):
    best=None
    for w in np.linspace(0.05,3,1190):
        A=fn(w)
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,a,rcond=None)[0]
        r=np.mean((A@c-a)**2)/np.var(a)

def big(w):
    C=np.cos(w*t);S=np.sin(w*t)
    return np.column_stack(g+[q*C for q in g]+[q*S for q in g])
best=None
for w in np.linspace(0.3,0.5,801):
    A=big(w)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,a,rcond=None)[0]
    r=np.mean((A@c-a)**2)/np.var(a)
    if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,w,c)
print(best[0],best[1])
print(np.round(best[2],3))
